cases.refreshed: Build confidence with basic math concepts and practice skills used in math competitions at the Santa Teresa Junior Math Club. Concepts covered include rounding, solving with fractions, area, perimeter, data and graphs, money, polygons, angles, and decimals. For children in grades 3 through 5, geared toward ages 8 to 11. Free. Walk-ins are welcome until the session is full. Each session stands on its own, so you can join at any time. This program meets every other Monday from 8/24 - 11/30 from 4:15 PM-5:15 PM in the Santa Teresa Library Community Room or Group Study Room A, depending on the week. Please see the sign by the entrance for program location. It is led by a teen volunteer. Come join the fun and watch your math skills grow!

cases.refreshed: Are you a student in grades K-6 who needs help with homework? Tutors are available to help with homework on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from 4 p.m. - 5:30 p.m. No registration is required. Walk-ins are welcome as space allows. Basic school supplies will be provided. Please note: As a parent or caregiver, you must stay in the Courtyard or Children's Room while your child participates in the program. Homework Help will not be held on the following dates: September 7; October 12; November 2; November 11; November 23 to November 26; December 21 to January 4. Are you interested in volunteering for Homework Help? Please visit our volunteer page to find out how to be a Homework Help volunteer. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Join the Bay Area Quiz Club for fun trivia and friendly competition! Bay Area Quiz Club (BAQC) is a volunteer-run organization. We aim to have fun and enjoy quizzing in a friendly, inclusive environment. The focus of the club is to build a community around in-person quizzing in the Bay Area. Our quizzes take place from 2-6 PM on the second Sunday of every month, at Mitchell Park Library, Palo Alto. It is free and open to everyone.

cases.refreshed: Drop in for a full day of modern board gaming at the Downtown Library! The group meets every 1st Saturday from 10 AM–6 PM. Attendees can bring their own games to play or jump in with others. Please bring your own snacks and drinks to fuel an afternoon of marathon gaming in the El Camino Room. Presented by The Bay Area Boardgames Meetup Group. Masks are not required in the Palo Alto Libraries, but are recommended.
